name: Document parsing and OCR
description: Read text, with positions, out of a file stored in the organization's media (PDF, Office, image). The engine and its credentials are the kernel's; the plugin names only the file.

capabilities.name: Parse a stored file
capabilities.description: Extract text and blocks from a media file, running OCR on scanned pages: directly (ocr::parse), as a queued job with a callback (ocr::submit, ocr::result), and the engine's state (ocr::status).
